user.title: Add a Kiosk Satellite
user.description: Type the tablet's address. Kiosk Mgmt tries HTTPS and then HTTP on the admin port unless you choose one. Leave certificate checking off for the self-signed certificate Kiosk Satellite creates.

data_description.host: IP address or host name, with no http:// prefix.
data_description.port: Remote Administration port. 2324 unless you changed it on the tablet.
data_description.scheme: Detect automatically tries HTTPS first, then HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off trusts the tablet's own certificate. On requires a certificate this Home Assistant already trusts.

confirm.title: Set up Kiosk Mgmt
confirm.description: Found {name} at {host} ({model}). Kiosk Mgmt will keep looking for other Kiosk Satellite tablets on this network.

reconfigure.title: Choose a kiosk
reconfigure.description: Pick the tablet whose address or certificate check you want to change.

reconfigure_connection.title: Update {name}
reconfigure_connection.description: Protocol, port, and certificate checking for this tablet.

data_description.scheme: Detect automatically tries HTTPS first, then HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off trusts the tablet's own certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach a Kiosk Satellite admin page at that address. Remote Administration has to be on, with a password set.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535.
error.ssl_error: The tablet answered on HTTPS, but the certificate check failed. Turn off Verify SSL certificate for a self-signed certificate.
error.already_tracked: That tablet is already in Kiosk Mgmt.

abort.already_configured: Kiosk Mgmt is already set up. Newly found tablets are added to it.
abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach a Kiosk Satellite admin page at that address.
abort.not_kiosk_satellite: That advertisement is not a Kiosk Satellite.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Kiosk Mgmt is already set up. Add another tablet from its options.

init.title: Kiosk Mgmt
init.description: Add a tablet by address, or change one that was already found.

add.title: Add a kiosk
add.description: Type the tablet's address. Detection tries HTTPS first, then HTTP.

data_description.host: IP address or host name, with no http:// prefix.
data_description.port: Remote Administration port. 2324 unless you changed it on the tablet.
data_description.scheme: Detect automatically tries HTTPS first, then HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off trusts the tablet's own certificate. On requires a certificate this Home Assistant already trusts.

kiosk.title: {name}
kiosk.description: Edit the address, ignore the tablet, or remove it.

data_description.scheme: Detect automatically tries HTTPS first, then HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Off trusts the tablet's own certificate.

ignore.title: Ignore {name}
ignore.description: {name} will disappear from the panel and will not be added again when it is discovered. You can show it again from this screen.

include.title: Show {name} again
include.description: {name} will be probed and shown in the panel.

remove.title: Remove {name}
remove.description: {name} will be removed. If the tablet is still on the network, discovery can add it again.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach a Kiosk Satellite admin page at that address. Remote Administration has to be on, with a password set.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address and a port from 1 to 65535.
error.ssl_error: The tablet answered on HTTPS, but the certificate check failed. Turn off Verify SSL certificate for a self-signed certificate.
error.already_tracked: That tablet is already in Kiosk Mgmt.

offline.title: {name} is offline
offline.description: Kiosk Mgmt cannot reach {name} at {host}. Check that the tablet is on, and that Remote Administration in Kiosk Satellite is on with a password set.

certificate.title: {name} certificate is not trusted
certificate.description: The certificate for {name} at {host} failed verification. Kiosk Satellite uses a self-signed certificate unless you imported one. Turn off Verify SSL certificate for this kiosk, or give it a certificate this Home Assistant trusts.

ignore_kiosk.name: Ignore kiosk
ignore_kiosk.description: Stop managing a kiosk. It stays ignored if it is discovered again.

kiosk_id.name: Kiosk
kiosk_id.description: The id of the kiosk to ignore.

remove_kiosk.name: Remove kiosk
remove_kiosk.description: Remove a kiosk. A later discovery can add it again.

kiosk_id.name: Kiosk
kiosk_id.description: The id of the kiosk to remove.
